title: Author the review-report contract and validator
description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/review-report.schema.json as a flat markdown-frontmatter schema (required: schema_version const 1.0, project, reviewed_at date-time, decision enum approved|changes_requested; additionalProperties true, like handoff.schema.json). Add validateReviewReport(frontmatter, root) to cli/lib/validate.js using validateMarkdownArtifact, export it, import + re-export it in cli/appbuilder.js, and append 'review-report' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first: validateReviewReport unit tests (valid frontmatter passes; bad decision and missing required fields fail).
acceptance_criteria: review-report.schema.json validates flat frontmatter with a decision enum of approved|changes_requested.
validateReviewReport is exported from cli/lib/validate.js and re-exported from cli/appbuilder.js.
